This Criminal Original Petitions have been filed seeking to call for the records in C.C.Nos.2499,
2498 and 2500 of 2017 on the file of the learned Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Egmore,
Chennai for alleged offences under Sections 120B r/w 420, 468 & 471 of IPC and quash the same as against the petitioner.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that though there are several arguable points available in this case, he is not pressing the application.

He further submitted that the petitioner is aged about 74 years and he is under dialysis and thereby, he would only pray that since the entire case of the prosecution is borne out by the documents, the presence of the petitioner before the Trial Court may be dispensed with unless otherwise required by the trial Court.
3. Taking into consideration the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, the presence of the petitioner before the trial Court shall be dispensed with on condition that he shall be present before the trial Court on initial questioning, reply to charges and at the time of framing charges and questioning under Section 313 of Cr.P.C., and at the time of passing judgment and whenever insisted upon by the trial court.
4. The petitioner is further directed to give an undertaking in the form of affidavit that he will be duly represented by a counsel on all hearing dates and that the Counsel representing him will cross examine the prosecution https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis witnesses on the same day they are examined in chief or on any subsequent date fixed by the trial Judge.
The petitioner shall not dispute the identity of the witnesses.
The petitioner shall appear before the Court in the event his presence is insisted by the trial Judge for the purpose of identification or progress in trial.
